title: Normalized compact-support trace in an arbitrary affine vector presentation
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting, B a Noetherian scheme of finite type over P.field.k with structure map aB, and F a finite locally free module of rank d on B [def-pur-conventions, def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section]. Let q be the ordered affine projection A^d_B to B and pi the vector-bundle projection. For any scheme isomorphism e:E(F) to A^d_B over B, any normalized twist transport t and normalized P1 datum family D, form the normalized compact-support affine trace tau from the inverse ordered coefficient descent, inverse affineLinearCompactComparison, affineTraceCounit and singleFunctorObjUnitIso. Form tau-prime from Rpi_! of inverse coefficient pullback followed by vectorBundleIntegration and the same unit comparison [def-amb-vector-integration-charts, def-amb-affine-linear-trace-action, def-amb-vector-integration]. Compact-support exchange for the Cartesian square (e,pi,q,id_B) on A_{A^d_B}(d)[2d], followed by Rpi_! of the coefficient comparison for e and tau-prime, equals identity pullback of tau followed by the actual monoidal unit pullback comparison. No zero-preserving or linearity condition on e is imposed. This is an equality of compact-support traces; it has no adjunction mate, section restriction, DNC or site comparison.

proof.text: Construct the standard inverse free frame k:A^d_B→E(F0) explicitly from the top-open frame. Its over equation and invertibility are proved geometrically. Evaluate the one fixed standard-frame normalization.

Apply the existing finite_trace_cartesian proof to the Cartesian isomorphism e.hom≫k from E(F) to E(F0) over id_B. That proof has no zero-preserving assumption. It derives the trace equation from independently normalized vector purity and its base-change law.

Replace the specified twist transport by the canonical one using uniqueness. Strict composition of normalized compact-support transport factors the action of e.hom≫k. Cancel the invertible action of k against the standard-frame equation.

The monoidal-unit pullback along the identity equals the identity-pullback comparison at the monoidal unit: derive this from its composition law, the identity compositor unit law, naturality and cancellation. Naturality of identity pullback then restores exactly the displayed equation.

theorem affineVectorTracePresentation (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (B : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian B]
    (aB : B ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aB] [QuasiCompact aB]
    (d : ℕ) (F : B.Modules) [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (t : Etale.OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates)
    (D : ∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
      (hT : IsUnit (P.diagonalExponent : Γ(T, ⊤))),
      Etale.OrdinaryFiniteP1Datum P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t T hT) :
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).1
    letI := (Etale.vectorIntegration_geometry B d F).2.1
    let q := affineTraceProjection B d
    let π := VectorBundleZeroSection.π B d F
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P q aB
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P π aB
    ∀ (e : VectorBundleZeroSection.scheme B d F ≅ affineTraceTower B d)
      (we : e.hom ≫ q = π),
      let sq : IsPullback e.hom π q (𝟙 B) :=
        IsPullback.of_horiz_isIso ⟨we.trans (Category.comp_id _).symm⟩
      let c (T S : Scheme.{u}) (f : T ⟶ S) (aS : S ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) :=
        Etale.vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t f (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aS) d
      let L := Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) q
      let L' := Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) π
      let τ := L.map
          ((Etale.affineLinearCoefficientDescent P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
              P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d) ≪≫
            c _ _ q aB).inv ≫
        (Etale.affineLinearCompactComparison P.diagonalExponent
          (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d).inv ≫
        Etale.affineTraceCounit P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates t D B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d ≫
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).hom
      let τ' := L'.map (c _ _ π aB).inv ≫
        Etale.vectorBundleIntegration P.diagonalExponent
          (pow_pos P.coefficients.prime.out.pos P.level) P.Coefficient
          P.diagonalExponent_annihilates B (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit aB) d F ≫
        (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) B).hom
      (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap P.Coefficient sq).app
          (Etale.affineLinearBaseCoefficient P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
            P.diagonalExponent_annihilates (affineTraceTower B d) d) ≫
        L'.map (c _ _ e.hom (q ≫ aB)).hom ≫ τ' =
      (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient (𝟙 B)).map τ ≫
        (Etale.leftDerivedUpperStarUnitIso
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) (𝟙 B)).hom
